title: Verify conditional marker slot consumer
platforms: EUR original source; Windows executable under Wine
changes: Add an isolated original slot-consumer test for both authenticated conditional OBJ marker lists, including clipping and disabled-context, zero-count and null-pointer guards.
validation: Windows GNU release test build and exact filtered Wine execution pass: six cases compare complete predicted OBJ buffer and cursor, full EWRAM and out-of-stack IWRAM, callee registers, stack and video memory. ROM, source and test executable guards passed and successful scratch was removed. Evidence: target/validation/units/e128-obj-marker-consumer-build-ozg_6sdh/ and e128-obj-marker-consumer-wine-6n_m9dtb/.
The first Wine launch supplied wine twice and failed before executing the test; diagnostics are retained in e128-obj-marker-consumer-wine-_ppq79yq/.
limitations: Synthetic isolated interpreter call only: no publication, translated native or managed reads, ordinary scene or paired comparison. Other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
